The main takeaway from our work is that
the sum-over-states expressions for the diamagnetic and paramagneticelectron orbit contributions are not independent of each other.
the gauge transformation of the magnetic field associated with a nuclear magnetic moment is equivalent to a gauge transformation of the corresponding vector potential.
gauge invariance is not a property of individual terms, but of response properties.
